I_record: unchanged format; for C/C0 the wait_start/wait_end of a read are those of the wait that announced it (its consuming node in C)

T_record.requirement: R5-00 INSTRUMENTATION to_add_in_phase1: per-thread hook start/end and wait start/end per expert node; node kind awaited; deferred reads already complete at their wait
T_record.written_by: every thread, every expert node, every arm (B, C0_I, C_I identical layout)

critical_path_reconstruction.H: per decode event min(T_tail, W) on B traces (ets_trace.metrics_from_log); one shot in Phase 1b
critical_path_reconstruction.decode_tokens: graphs whose R records have n_tokens == 1
critical_path_reconstruction.exposed_store_ms_per_token: sum over decode nodes of (max hook_out - min hook_in) / decode tokens
critical_path_reconstruction.exposed_wait_ms_per_token: sum over decode nodes of max over threads (wait_end - wait_start) / decode tokens
critical_path_reconstruction.hidden_deferred_bytes_fraction: deferred reads (issued in the first node's window, kind != first node's kind) whose completion <= earliest wait_start of their consuming node, by bytes
critical_path_reconstruction.implementation: ets_trace.py (structure() for Phase 1a, metrics() for Phase 1b/2 only)
critical_path_reconstruction.node: (graph, layer, kind); start = min over threads of hook_in_ns; store phase end = max over threads of hook_out_ns

not_measured: true device completion of a read not observed before its wait (upper bound, conservative)
time inside the ggml kernel (bounded by hook gaps)

stderr_counters_line.when: process exit (graceful), every launch, every arm

stderr_identity_line: argine: attesa expert: <layer|layer_touch|kind> (<esplicita|default>), ARGINE_PREFETCH=<value>, schema r5-ets-v1
